title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wow! Thank you! I can't believe how many you got!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Were you using techniques pioneered by ancient Japanese masters or something? You were so brilliant, I would believe it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right! We need to take a picture to commemorate this!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer, let's take one together! We can use one of those special booths that prints stickers! ♪
